description: Runs the site's ROI calculator: from team size, weekly manual hours, hourly cost and error rate it estimates annual hours saved, annual savings, implementation cost, ROI percent and payback months, plus the service recommendations the page shows. Use it when a user wants a number for the value of automating a process. Optional industry preset sets the automation efficiency.

automationEfficiency.description: Share of manual hours automation removes (default 0.70; presets use 0.60 to 0.75)

employees.description: People doing the manual work (1 to 100)

errorRate.description: Percent of manual work containing errors (0 to 25)

hourlyCost.description: Fully loaded hourly cost per person, CAD (15 to 150)

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours per person per week on manual tasks (1 to 40)

industry.description: Optional preset; fills any input left out and sets automationEfficiency unless given explicitly

name: estimate_roi
title: Estimate automation ROI
